findings.detail: RecursiveReviewScope: invariants include complete recursive review inputs and the correct immutable repository/revision context for applicable guidance. Ratings: encapsulation 7/10, invariant expression 6/10, invariant usefulness 9/10, invariant enforcement 6/10. The new traversal includes module/src/file.go, but render_guides resolves module/AGENTS.md using only the superproject's baseline and object database. That lookup cannot traverse the gitlink, so required historical child instructions are omitted while the prompt prohibits using checkout instructions. A validated recursive scope can therefore produce a successful review without its applicable checks.
findings.fix: Resolve each child's repository and trusted revision from the parent baseline gitlink, recursively, and use that context for historical guide lookup. Handle children absent from the baseline explicitly and report unavailable required historical objects rather than substituting current child HEAD.
findings.title: write-bash-scripts: Checked commands: Recursive scopes omit trusted child guidance context.
